matrix.title: OpenAPI Diff & Client Synchronization
matrix.description: API contract is documented via OpenAPI 3.1.0, exported deterministically, and reflected synchronously in generated client types without unapproved breaking changes.
required_checks: packages/openapi-client/openapi.json matches live FastAPI route definitions
Breaking changes are classified and validated against approved breaking changes register
matrix.gap_or_blocker_note: Artifact and client are byte-exact synchronized. Diff against an approved prior release cannot be attested because candidate C is an initial dev release without prior approved contract baseline. Diffing against C itself or moving dev is prohibited.

matrix.title: Event Schema Compatibility
matrix.description: Asynchronous events, domain ingestion states, and cross-boundary message contracts are schema-governed and validated against typed fixtures.
required_checks: Domain intake events conform to JSON Schema definitions
State machine transitions conform to domain intake lifecycles
Canonical schemas in packages/schemas/ validate without drift

candidate_evidence.execution_result: PASS (unit & contract schema assertions passed on candidate C)

matrix.gap_or_blocker_note: Event schemas conform internally on candidate C. Cross-release event backward compatibility over long replay windows requires staging live verification.

matrix.title: Data Platform Foundation & Product Contract Pinning
matrix.description: ODay Plus consumes the data platform via immutable pinned contract release packages, verifying digests and avoiding raw producer database table dependencies.
required_checks: Foundation client pinned to exact release oday-data-foundation-contracts.v0.4.1
Product client pinned to exact release oday-data-product-contracts.v0.4.1
Data contract digest matches release manifest data_contract_digest

candidate_evidence.execution_result: PASS (77 test cases across data contract pin suites passed on candidate C)

matrix.gap_or_blocker_note: Data contract pin tests pass and match manifest digests. Deployed data-plane reconciliation against live database requires Gate 2 (Data Gate) post-deployment verification.

matrix.title: Model Input / Output Contract Compatibility
matrix.description: Model parameter schemas, simulation writebacks, and scoring API contracts are typed and validate input/output envelopes.
required_checks: Pricing simulation writeback contract enforces idempotency and parameter validation
Heatzone composition schemas validate geographic and score bounds
Operator scoring and governance API response envelopes conform

candidate_evidence.execution_result: PASS (45 test cases passed on candidate C)

matrix.gap_or_blocker_note: Model interface contracts pass in candidate C. Gate 3 (Model & Solver Gate) retains responsibility for dataset snapshot reproducibility, segment metrics, solver feasibility, and Human/Ops ML risk approval.

matrix.title: Breaking Change Migration, Compatibility Window & Rollback Plan
matrix.description: Schema and interface changes follow expand/contract patterns without destructive down migrations, and provide unambiguous rollback/recovery semantics.
required_checks: Expand/contract migration policy documented and enforced
Initial release recovery semantics bound to candidate C
No unapproved breaking changes in approved breaking changes registry
matrix.gap_or_blocker_note: Candidate C dev deployment uses initial release recovery (delete-candidate-zero-traffic). Retains blocked status per registry rules; release decision remains NO-GO.
